name: Yuuki Chidori
source:
The head hostess and matriarch of the Yuuki family. She was once in love with Ryouichi's father, which is why she helps Ryouichi out now. She is a very sexy older woman who runs her restaurant like a pro. Her dream is for Ryouichi and one of her daughters to succeed her in the restaurant's ownership.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Come_See_Me_Tonight]Wikipedia[/url]]
